[[File:Paul Todd Feldman Red 16 Decipher squadron portrait.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Paul Todd Feldman (Red 16).]]
'''Paul Todd Feldman''' (DRTORCH) was a World Finalist in 1996, 1997, 1999, and 2000. His team won the [[DecipherCon 1999 Team Event]] with [[Martin Akesson]], [[Koen Meijssen]] and [[Yannick Lapointe]].<ref name="drazin" /><ref name="trando-iv7">[https://web.archive.org/web/20041026204829/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/iv7.htm Martin Akesson interview], [[Trandosite]] (31 August 2000)</ref> In a 2025 interview he called himself "the champion for 99 of world of the team".<ref name="drtorch-int">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=b9f9tNBiU2I SWCCG PDS2: DRTORCH Worlds Finalist 1996, 1997, 1999, 2000 Interview] (BillBisco2, 29 May 2025; auto-captions). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261014143045/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=b9f9tNBiU2I Internet Archive]</ref> He also played the [[2025 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2025-04-retro-gemp-match-play-championship-premiere-to-dsii-may-to-july-2025/ 2025 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020232324/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2025-04-retro-gemp-match-play-championship-premiere-to-dsii-may-to-july-2025.html Internet Archive]</ref>

He won the [[Retro League]] in 2022 and 2023<ref name="rl-pc2023">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/retro-league-set-to-return-for-second-installment-event-1-starts-jan-13/ Retro League Set to Return for Second Installment], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012164332/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/retro-league-set-to-return-for-second-installment-event-1-starts-jan-13.html Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="rl-2023">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=82168 2023 Retro GEMP League], forum.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012162359/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t82168.html Internet Archive].</ref> and was runner-up in the 2024 Retro Online Championship Series.<ref name="rl-rocs24">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2024-11-retro-online-championship-series-rocs-playoffs-dec-2024/ 2024-11 Retro Online Championship Series (ROCS) Playoffs], starwarsccg.org (23 December 2024). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012164730/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2024-11-retro-online-championship-series-rocs-playoffs-dec-2024.html Internet Archive].</ref>

Feldman hosted [[Winfried Sommerfeld]] of Germany for a game in Turlock during Sommerfeld's US trip with his wife Marianne; [[Jason Drake]] is also in the photo of the visit.<ref name="torch-turlock">[http://members.aol.com/drtorch/turlock.html Winfred Sommerfeld and Paul Todd Feldman], Torch Industries (members.aol.com/drtorch). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030715063940/http://members.aol.com/drtorch/turlock.html Internet Archive]</ref> Sommerfeld named Feldman among the friends he made through the game.<ref name="decsq-sommerfeld">[http://decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/players/sommerfeldwinfried.html Star Wars CCG Squadrons: Red 41], decipher.com (page last modified 28 June 1999). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001023104822/http://decipher.com:80/volunteers/squadrons/players/sommerfeldwinfried.html Internet Archive]</ref>
